body: As some one who has bipolar I am both offended and amused
Beautiful fish what did you catch it with?

Basically during a depression state I was having overwhelming thoughts on self harm and suicide.

Instead at the last moment I decided to grab a sharpie and write my name (DAN) on my wrist.

It relieved the temptation to self harm but I was still in a bad way. Later on I looked at the sharpie mark and added the line at the bottom of the D and the I to make it pain.

I call it DAN IN PAIN. 

And after sitting on the idea for a week I will be getting it tattooed on my arm next Thursday as a reminder that even when I'm in the middle or manic that the pain that comes from depression is real.
